name: Israel, Gaza and the West Bank

status.en: 122 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 122 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: Settlers in the occupied West Bank have attacked European diplomats, a US photographer and a French mayor, torching cars and olive trees and wounding farmers. Israeli officials, including Netanyahu, have cast doubt on the settler attacks despite evidence captured by reporters. Qatar transferred funds to Hamas-ruled Gaza before Oct. 7, a flow overseen by Israel, while Trump has endorsed Netanyahu ahead of elections. UNICEF reports 340 children killed in Gaza despite a ceasefire, and the World Food Programme head describes life as absolutely brutal for Gaza residents. The conflict caused 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Settlere i den okkuperte Vestbredden har angrepet europeiske diplomater, en amerikansk fotograf og en fransk ordfører, brent biler og oliventrær og såret bønder. Israelske tjenestemenn, inkludert Netanyahu, har stilt spørsmål ved bosetterangrepene til tross for bevis fanget av journalister. Qatar overførte penger til Hamas-styrte Gaza før 7. oktober, en strøm som ble overvåket av Israel, mens Trump har støttet Netanyahu før valget. UNICEF rapporterer at 340 barn ble drept i Gaza til tross for en våpenhvile, og lederen for Verdens matprogram beskriver livet som helt brutalt for Gaza-innbyggere. Konflikten forårsaket 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters, including the United States, deny that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
